claims.text: Linear probes on Llama-2-13B-chat residual activations reproduce TalkTuner's published demographic probe accuracies for age, gender, education, and socioeconomic status within a pre-stated band.
claims.evidence: Protocol preregistered before the single GPU run in /home/hal/dev/interp/dm_hack/mats_open/auto_interp/PREREG.md: band = published minus 0.12 per task, anchor IN_BAND iff all four tasks in band; instrument hashes committed there (convgen.py e13f610a65fd..., dataset.jsonl 8a67e05589e5..., run_probe_study.py 36b63d8bcce5...). Data: dataset.jsonl, 6068 seeded deterministic single-turn conversations, indirect cues only (forbidden-pattern lint in out/convgen_selftest.txt, PASS), 12 cue families per class split 7 train / 2 val / 3 test so the test set is template-disjoint (dataset_manifest.json). Run: one Lambda A100 40GB, meta-llama/Llama-2-13b-chat-hf fp16, instance 56d3d3dfe2d646d49d5957cee46f37fd, TalkTuner-faithful readout: last-token residual of appended message 'I think the {attribute} of this user is', all 41 layers, logistic C=1 per layer, layer chosen on val families, reported once on test families. Committed results (out/results_probe/out/probe_summary_{task}.json, per-item rows included; raw fp16 activations in acts_{task}.npz): anchor_age test 0.9467 (published 0.98, band >=0.86, n_test 244, layer 27, perm 0.189/0.197) IN_BAND; anchor_education test 0.9399 (published 0.96, band >=0.84, n_test 183, layer 23) IN_BAND but PERM_ANOMALY: permuted-label accuracies 0.546/0.410 vs chance 0.333 exceed the prestated |mean-chance|<=0.104 gate, so its decision is not claimable per PREREG; anchor_ses test 1.0000 (published 0.97, band >=0.85, n_test 183, layer 32, perm 0.383/0.202) IN_BAND at ceiling; anchor_gender test 0.4467 (published 0.94, band >=0.82, n_test 150, chance 0.50, layer 6, perm 0.493/0.527) OUT_OF_BAND and below chance, while its val accuracy was 0.980 at the same layer, i.e. the gender probe generalized to val families but collapsed on the disjoint test families (full confusion in the record rows). Aggregate record probe_summary_ALL.json: anchor_in_band = false. Verification controls exist and are runnable read-only: 'python3 controls/recheck_rows.py out/results_probe/out/probe_summary_anchor_gender.json' re-derives the accuracy from rows (MATCH on all 10 records), and 'bash controls/retrain_probe.sh anchor_gender' retrains from the raw committed activations at the recorded layer (REPRODUCES). Positive readout control: 16-way topic probe test 1.0000 vs chance 0.0625, permutations 0.119/0.045 (probe_summary_poscontrol_topic.json).

claims.text: A linear probe on Llama-2-13B-chat residual activations recovers the user's expertise level above chance on held-out synthetic single-turn conversations in which the attribute is planted only via indirect cues.
claims.evidence: Protocol and instruments as preregistered in PREREG.md before the single GPU run (hashes committed there; generator lint PASS in out/convgen_selftest.txt; template-disjoint test families). Committed result out/results_probe/out/probe_summary_ext_expertise.json: test accuracy 0.8333, n_test 150, chance 0.50, binary, best layer 12 (chosen on val, val 1.000), permutation controls 0.393/0.453 (within the prestated chance +/- 0.122 gate). Prestated rule: RECOVERED iff test_acc >= 0.6225 (= chance + max(0.10, 3*se), se 0.0408); AT_CHANCE iff <= 0.5816. Decision recorded: RECOVERED. Per-item rows re-derive the number exactly ('python3 controls/recheck_rows.py out/results_probe/out/probe_summary_ext_expertise.json' -> MATCH) and the probe retrains from raw committed activations ('bash controls/retrain_probe.sh ext_expertise' -> REPRODUCES, 0.8333). GATE: the preregistered anchor requirement failed (probe_summary_ALL.json: anchor_in_band=false, driven by anchor_gender test 0.4467 vs band >=0.82), and QUESTION.md:13-15 states an out-of-band anchor voids every extension claim; so this measured number is committed but not claimable as attribute recovery under the protocol. Declared construct risk applies (QUESTION.md:24-27): the probe may read surface cue tokens (here, topic-slotted jargon-density cue sentences) rather than a user model; indirect-cue construction is the mitigation, not a proof. Readout instrument positive control: topic probe 1.0000 vs chance 0.0625 (probe_summary_poscontrol_topic.json).

claims.text: A linear probe on Llama-2-13B-chat residual activations recovers the user's formality preference above chance on held-out synthetic single-turn conversations in which the attribute is planted only via indirect cues.
claims.evidence: Protocol and instruments as preregistered in PREREG.md before the single GPU run (hashes committed there; generator lint PASS in out/convgen_selftest.txt; template-disjoint test families; formality is a style task: the class is realized in whole-message register, formal vs casual skeletons). Committed result out/results_probe/out/probe_summary_ext_formality.json: test accuracy 1.0000, n_test 96, chance 0.50, best layer 3 (val 1.000), BUT permutation controls 0.604/0.719 (mean 0.661) exceed the prestated |mean-chance| <= max(0.05, 3*se)=0.153 gate, so the record's decision is RECOVERED+PERM_ANOMALY and by PREREG the decision is not claimable: at layer 3 even probes trained on shuffled labels score above chance on true test labels, meaning the register signal is so strong and low-level that the permutation instrument check fails for this task. Prestated rule: RECOVERED iff test_acc >= 0.6531 (se 0.051). Rows re-derive the number exactly ('python3 controls/recheck_rows.py out/results_probe/out/probe_summary_ext_formality.json' -> MATCH); probe retrains from raw activations ('bash controls/retrain_probe.sh ext_formality' -> REPRODUCES). GATE: the preregistered anchor also failed (probe_summary_ALL.json: anchor_in_band=false), voiding every extension claim per QUESTION.md:13-15. Declared construct risk (QUESTION.md:24-27) is maximal here: register IS surface form; a linear probe reading token-level register features is indistinguishable in this design from one reading a user model.

claims.evidence: Protocol and instruments as preregistered in PREREG.md before the single GPU run (hashes committed there; generator lint PASS in out/convgen_selftest.txt; template-disjoint test families; style task: fluent skeletons vs L1-transfer grammar-error skeletons, the attribute itself never named). Committed result out/results_probe/out/probe_summary_ext_native.json: test accuracy 0.8125, n_test 96, chance 0.50, best layer 2 (val 1.000), permutation controls 0.521/0.688 (mean 0.604, inside the prestated chance +/- 0.153 gate, no anomaly flag but the margin is thin: one permutation run scored 0.688). Prestated rule: RECOVERED iff test_acc >= 0.6531. Decision recorded: RECOVERED. Rows re-derive the number exactly ('python3 controls/recheck_rows.py out/results_probe/out/probe_summary_ext_native.json' -> MATCH); probe retrains from raw activations ('bash controls/retrain_probe.sh ext_native' -> REPRODUCES). GATE: the preregistered anchor failed (probe_summary_ALL.json: anchor_in_band=false), voiding every extension claim per QUESTION.md:13-15. Best layer being 2 (very early) is consistent with a surface-token reading.
